notices.text:
Your fare claim is closed with no refund.

Your trip was a fixed-price RydeX ride, so the fare doesn't change based on the distance driven, and nothing was added on top of the quoted price. That leaves nothing to refund.

What it does mean: our records confirm the driver took a longer route than needed for part of the trip, and that has been noted on their file. Nothing changes for you — no refund is due on a fixed quote.

Thanks for flagging it.

Your trip was reviewed and the fare stands — no refund was issued, and no money is taken from you.

One thing was recorded against your file: between 09:06 and 09:13 you drove a stretch that took you well off the shortest direct route, by about 5 km in total.

A GPS rerouting explanation can't cover this one, since no traffic incident was recorded on your route at that time and you didn't agree a different route with the rider beforehand.
